voiceoverSegments.line: First, we load candle data — the raw price history our strategy reads from.
Then we add the MACD indicator, set to twelve, twenty-six, and nine periods, to track momentum shifts.
We plot the MACD line so the momentum is visible on the chart.
A second plot draws the signal line, so we can watch when it crosses above or below the MACD.
And a third plots the histogram — the gap between the two.

outro.voiceover: And there it is — the MACD plotted live on the chart, ready to backtest.
